answer: Agents can forge provenance for a sonnet or raven recording. Propose separate fraud insurance per seller key: at least 2 credits/day, nonrefundable. Escrow validators check insurer signatures, full coverage, expiry, distinct premium payments and exclusive key binding; failure blocks sales. Insurers pay refunds upheld by market arbiters. Honest, solvent insurers and fair arbitration are assumed; wealth buys aliases. Servers are reusable capital; no stake. Shared hosts and parallel keys cannot share policies: ten keys spend at least 20 credits/day.
